meta_description: 5,967 likes, 58 comments - athleanx on August 5, 2026: "Don’t forget the “other” glute muscle! Everyone wants to develop bigger, stronger glutes but they overlook the “medius” in an over enthusiasm for the “maximus”. Yeah I get it. Instagram rewards those chasing the glute max gains but trust me…the rest of us, the ones suffering from chronic low back pain and seem to have no particular cause that we can pinpoint for the issue? That’s who needs to wake up to the importance of the glute medius and ultimately wake up a muscle that lies far too dormant,  under activated and weak. Try this simple hip bump exercise and you’ll target it without needing elaborate equipment, space or setup! Let the gains begin and let me know how it works for you! #glutemedius #glutes #notpeaches #gym #athleanx".
